title: Mesh imports reconstruct as native feature histories
summary: Desktop STL, OBJ, 3MF, PLY, GLB/glTF, OFF, AMF, STEP/STP, and BREP/BRP imports now run through an in-process native reconstructor that emits one base body with analytical contours and local additive/subtractive features; the former FreeCAD/Python slab converter is removed.
